title: Cheese & Lava
description: Cheese items, biome and lava chicken, cooked eggs, bucket of lava chicken and more.
body:
Cheese & Lava

Cheese & Lava is a Minecraft mod that adds new foods, blocks, recipes, and a unique biome called Cheesme.
It’s a food-and-adventure mod that lets players explore a world full of cheesy creations and tasty surprises.

Features

6 New Foods – including Lava Chicken and other cheese-inspired dishes. Cook, eat, and enjoy new ways to restore hunger or experiment with your inventory.

4 New Blocks – build with cheese-themed blocks or use them to decorate your base in creative ways.

11 Crafting Recipes & 2 Smelting Recipes – craft foods, blocks, and unique items that aren’t available in vanilla Minecraft.

Cheesme Biome – a brand-new biome filled with unique blocks, terrain, and secrets to explore. Perfect for players who love exploring unusual lands.

7 Advancements – complete special goals tied to foods, crafting, and exploration. Gives players extra challenges and rewards.

Cheese Guy Mob (Creative-Only) – a quirky, unique character you can spawn in creative mode to interact with your world. Adds fun flavor to builds and roleplay.

Why Download This Mod?

For the Adventure – explore the Cheesme biome and uncover new foods, blocks, and secrets.

For the Food Lovers – try out creative new foods, like Lava Chicken, that make survival more fun.

For Builders – use cheese-themed blocks to decorate bases, houses, or entire worlds.

For Challenge Seekers – complete the new advancements and test your crafting and exploration skills.

For Creative Fun – spawn the Cheese Guy and other items in creative mode to make unique builds or just have fun experimenting.
